title: JANUS Linear A R3A SigLA cross-digitization inventory audit specification

source_B.name: SigLA — The Signs of Linear A

question: Does an independently maintained GORILA-derived digitization expose document-inventory/naming/coverage differences that could invalidate assumptions tied specifically to lineara.xyz before any content-level cross-digitization parser comparison?

execution.network_rule: Fetch SigLA browse.html during CI and record the exact HTTP bytes SHA-256; do not assume the live page is immutable.
execution.baseline_rule: Clone and checkout the frozen mwenge commit before deriving its item inventory.
execution.parser_rule: Use an independent HTMLParser-based SigLA inventory extractor. Do not import lineara.xyz parsing code for SigLA HTML.
execution.normalization_rule: Compare both raw document IDs and a separately declared conservative canonical-ID transform. Preserve all disagreements and collisions.

operations: remove no side markers such as a/b
preserve punctuation, angle brackets, Greek suffixes and uncertain markers
forbidden: manual name equivalence based on expected overlap
dropping side suffixes to increase overlap
mapping one source identifier to another using semantic/transcription content

predeclared_outputs: SigLA browse HTTP status/final URL/content SHA-256/content length
sample disagreements selected deterministically by lexical ordering

gates.G1_FETCH: SigLA browse page must return HTTP 200 and non-empty bytes.
gates.G2_PARSE: SigLA extractor must find at least 700 distinct document IDs and exactly match the page's stated corpus count if that count is parseable.
gates.G3_BASELINE: Frozen mwenge checkout must match the declared commit and contain at least 1500 item HTML files.
gates.G4_NO_COLLISION_HIDING: Any normalization collision is preserved and blocks using normalized IDs as a one-to-one identity bridge.
gates.G5_CLAIM_CEILING: This stage may establish cross-digitization inventory agreement/disagreement only; it cannot establish independent transcription replication, lexical meaning, anchor novelty, or decipherment.
